ursachen.warum: Right after cooking the juice is thin and the fibres are under tension.
fix: Rest steaks for 5 minutes, roasts for 10–20 minutes

ursachen.warum: The bigger the temperature difference between edge and centre, the more tension and juice.
fix: Cook more gently, e.g. reverse sear

ursachen.warum: Long, open fibres let juice run out more easily.
